blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.
blocks.zh: 跨越多种观点的空间推理需要从2D观测中推断出物体与相机之间的3D关系,这取决于交叉视图的对应和场景几何,视觉语言模型(VLMs)不能可靠地提取. 预先训练的视觉编码器已经在其潜伏的特性中捕捉到这种信息,CLIP将对象与图像区域联系起来,DINOv3匹配跨视图的语义,以及VGGT编码多视图几何. 然而,当我们直接把它们作为灰色尺度的特征图像呈现时,VLM并没有从这些特征中受益. 因此,我们提议LatentParse这一无培训框架,将潜在特征描述为VLM的明确空间证据。 在LatentParse中,一位分析师VLM用预先定义的工具探测所有三个编码器的特性,这些编码器可以定位物体,在视图之间跟踪它们,并在视图之间测量运动. 然后将结果提炼成一份简明的文本报告,报告连同图像一起提供给VLM,以回答问题. 我们在MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench和SPAR-Bench上评价LatentParse,它使所有五个VLM平均比光线基线提高0.7-2.4个百分点。 在MMSI-Bench上,它将Quen3.8-27B从34.4%提升到39.5%,相机相关问题的最大改进度达到19.2个百分点. 这些结果表明,潜在特征一旦被解析成关系证据,而不经过培训,就有利于空间推理。 代码见https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in recognizing and describing visual content [ 21 , 34 ] , yet they still struggle to reason about the 3D layout of a scene and the motion of the camera [ 7 , 25 , 43 , 42 ] . Answering these questions requires inferring 3D relations such as the relative position, distance, and orientation between objects and viewpoints [ 13 , 1 , 42 ] . These relations are often underdetermined by a single image and must be recovered from cross-view correspondence and scene geometry, neither of which current VLMs explicitly model.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在识别和描述视觉内容[21,34]方面迅速进步,然而他们仍然在为一个场景的3D布局和相机的移动而挣扎着理性 [7,25,43,42]. 回答这些问题需要推断出三维关系,例如对象和观点之间的相对位置,距离和取向[13, 1, 42]. 这些关系往往由单一的图像来决定,必须从交叉视图的函证和场景几何中取回,而现在的VLM都明确标出模型.

blocks.en: Pretrained vision encoders offer a complementary source of this information. In particular, CLIP [ 29 ] , DINOv3 [ 32 ] and VGGT [ 35 ] are trained with image–text alignment, self-supervision and multi-view 3D supervision, respectively. Preliminary probing studies reveal that these features encode rich semantic and geometric information [ 4 , 26 , 2 , 50 ] , making them a reliable prior for spatial reasoning. Recent studies exploit this prior by training the VLMs to interpret encoder features. For example, Spatial-MLLM [ 39 ] , VG-LLM [ 51 ] and VLM-3R [ 5 ] connect visual encoders to the language model through learned projectors or fusion modules and fine-tune on spatial instruction data. Such training must be repeated for each encoder–VLM pair, which is computationally expensive and cannot be applied to closed-source VLMs. Training-free methods, including ViperGPT [ 33 ] , SpatialPIN [ 24 ] and SandboxVLM [ 23 ] , instead support reasoning with decoded outputs such as depth maps, reconstructions or 3D boxes. These outputs are fixed before the question is known and may discard the cross-view correspondence and region similarity that the latent features encode and many spatial questions require.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的视觉编码器提供了这一信息的补充来源。 尤其是CLIP [29],DINOv3 [32]和VGGT [35]分别接受了图像-文本对接,自监控和多视图3D监督的培训. 初步的探测研究表明,这些地物编码了丰富的语义和几何信息[4,26,2,50],使它们成为空间推理的可靠先行. 最近的研究利用了这一点,先是培训VLMs解释编码器的特性. 例如,Space-MLLM [39],VG-LLM [51]和VLM-3R [5]通过有学问的投影仪或聚变模块将视觉编码器与语言模型相连接,并微调空间指令数据. 每对编码器-VLM配对必须重复进行这种训练,计算费用昂贵,不能用于闭源VLM. 无培训方法,包括活蛇GPT [33],SpacePIN [24]和SandboxVLM [23],而是支持以深度地图,重建或3D盒等解码输出来进行推理. 这些产出在已知问题之前是固定的,可能放弃潜在地物编码和许多空间问题所要求的交叉视图对应和区域相似性。

blocks.en: A natural alternative is to use the latent features themselves as context, which require neither training nor decoding and leave the VLM free to decide what to measure for each question. However, as Figure 2 shows, presenting these latent features to a VLM naively as image input brings little benefit, likely because the information they carry lies in the relations between patches rather than in their appearance. To exploit these relations and realize these benefits, we propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses the relations between patches into explicit evidence and summarizes it in a text report that an arbitrary VLM can use in context, as illustrated in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 一个自然的替代办法是将潜在特征本身作为上下文使用,这既不需要培训,也不需要进行编解码,并允许自愿识别数据自由决定对每个问题进行何种衡量。 然而,正如图2所显示的,将这些潜在的特征天真地呈现给一个VLM,因为图像输入可能不会带来什么好处,因为它们所携带的信息在于补丁之间的关系,而不是它们的外观. 为了利用这些关系并实现这些好处,我们提议LatentParse(无培训框架),将补丁之间的关系描述成明确的证据,并在文本报告中加以总结,如图3所说明的,任意的VLM可以在上下文中使用。

blocks.en: LatentParse operates on the last-layer features of CLIP [ 29 ] , DINOv3 [ 32 ] and VGGT [ 35 ] , which respectively ground object names in image regions, compare regions within and across views, and relate the views geometrically. On these features, a library of tools locates named objects, tracks them across views, measures content motion, and rates each measurement by consensus. An analyst VLM that never sees the photos calls these tools in a Python sandbox [ 16 , 37 ] and writes a report. The same VLM then answers the question in a fresh context from the photos and this report. Keeping the analyst blind to the photos is intended to focus its report on tool measurements rather than direct photo inspection.
blocks.zh: LatentParse在CLIP [29],DINov3 [32]和VGGT [35] 的上层特征上运行,它们分别以图像区域为地标对象名称,比较了视界内和相通的区域,并用几何方式将视图相接. 在这些特征上,一个工具库可以定位被命名对象,跟踪其不同观点,测量内容运动,并以协商一致的方式对每项计量进行评分. 一个从未看到相片的分析师VLM在Python沙盒中称这些工具[16,37]并写出一份报告. 同一VLM随后从照片和这份报告的新上下文中回答了这个问题. 使分析师对照片视而不见是为了使其报告侧重于工具测量,而不是直接进行照片检查。

blocks.en: We evaluate LatentParse with five open and closed VLMs on three spatial reasoning benchmarks [ 43 , 6 , 49 ] . Across the benchmarks, our method raises the mean accuracy of every VLM over the photo-only baseline by 0.7 to 2.4 pp, whereas naive input changes accuracy on MMSI-Bench by only − 2.6 -2.6 to + 0.6 +0.6 pp. On MMSI-Bench, LatentParse improves Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest gains on camera-related questions, which rise from 31.4% to 50.6% as shown in Figure 1 . Using mismatched features from a different scene lowers accuracy to 33.3%, which indicates that the gain depends on features that match the scene.
blocks.zh: 我们用5个公开和封闭的VLM来评价LatentParse的3个空间推理基准[43,6,49]. 在整个基准中,我们的方法将每个VLM的平均精度高于光线基线,提高了0.7至2.4pp,而天真输入在MMSI-Bench的精度仅变化了2.6-2.6到+0.6+0.6pp. 在MMSI-Bench上,LatentParse将Quen3.8-27B从34.4%提高到39.5%,在相机相关问题上的收益最大,从31.4%上升到了50.6%,如图1所示。 使用不同场景的不匹配特征会将精度降低到33.3%,这表明收益取决于与场景相匹配的特征.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: • We propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that enables frozen VLMs to exploit the latent features of pretrained vision encoders for spatial reasoning by parsing these features into relation evidence through a photo-blind analyst and a textual report. • We design a library of latent-space tools for object localization, cross-view tracking, and motion estimation, which rely mainly on basis-invariant comparisons within each encoder and rate measurements by cross-encoder consensus, without any learned projector. • We evaluate five open- and closed-source VLMs on three benchmarks, where LatentParse improves the mean accuracy of every VLM over the photo-only baseline by 0.7 to 2.4 pp whereas the tested grayscale feature images yield no consistent gain. For Qwen3.8-27B on MMSI-Bench, the gain disappears with mismatched features, concentrates on camera questions and turns into a loss on multi-step reasoning.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的贡献如下: 我们提议LatentParse(无培训框架),使被冻结的VLM能够通过光盲分析员和文本报告将这些特性分析成相关证据,从而利用预先训练的视觉编码器的潜在特性进行空间推理。 我们设计了一套潜在空间工具库,用于物体本地化、交叉取景跟踪和运动估计,这些工具主要依靠每个编码器内部的基-变量比较和通过交叉编码器共识的速率测量,没有任何学习的投影仪。 我们在三个基准上评价了五个开源和闭源VLM,LatetParse将每个VLM的平均精度比光线基线提高0.7至2.4pp,而所测试的灰度地物图像没有取得一致的收益。 对于MMSI-Bench上的Quen3.8-27B来说,增益随着不匹配的特性而消失,专注于相机问题,并变成多步推理的损失.

blocks.en: We propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that enables frozen VLMs to exploit the latent features of pretrained vision encoders for spatial reasoning by parsing these features into relation evidence through a photo-blind analyst and a textual report.
blocks.zh: 我们建议LatentParse是一个无培训框架,使被冻结的VLM能够通过光盲分析员和文本报告将这些特性解析成关系证据,从而利用预先训练的视觉编码器的潜在特性进行空间推理。

For Qwen3.8-27B on MMSI-Bench, the gain disappears with mismatched features, concentrates on camera questions and turns into a loss on multi-step reasoning.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Spatial Reasoning in Vision Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 远景语言模型中的空间理由

blocks.en:
A growing body of benchmarks evaluates whether VLMs can infer scene geometry from a single image and relate observations across multiple views.
3DSRBench [ 25 ] focuses on depth order, orientation and object relations within a single image, whereas MMSI-Bench [ 43 ] , MindCube [ 36 ] and MV-RoboBench [ 6 ] require reasoning about camera motion, hypothetical movements and object correspondence across views.
SPAR-Bench [ 49 ] and VSI-Bench [ 42 ] further extend this evaluation to indoor scenes and video.
To improve performance on these benchmarks, most existing methods train the VLM itself.
SpatialVLM [ 1 ] is trained on synthetic spatial question-answer pairs, SpatialRGPT [ 3 ] learns regional representations from 3D scene graphs, and GASP [ 46 ] derives supervision from correspondence and depth consistency without relying on 3D VQA data.
Another line of work injects features from additional encoders through a trained connector, in the spirit of the pretrained projector in LLaVA-NeXT [ 21 ] .
Cambrian-1 [ 34 ] aggregates features from multiple encoders with a learned Spatial Vision Aggregator, while Spatial-MLLM [ 39 ] , VG-LLM [ 51 ] and VLM-3R [ 5 ] incorporate geometry features through learned connectors or fusion modules.
GeoReader [ 17 ] trains Readers that encode predicted depth and camera poses as continuous tokens, and subsequently fine-tunes the VLM for spatial QA with the Readers frozen.
Since such training has to be repeated for every encoder-VLM pair, these approaches are costly to extend and cannot be applied to closed-source VLMs.
In contrast, LatentParse requires neither a learned connector nor any VLM update.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的基准评价VLMs是否能够从一幅图像中推断出场景几何,并将多种观点的观测联系起来.
3DSR Bench [25] 专注于一幅图像中的深度顺序,取向和对象关系,而MMSI-Bench [43],MindCube [36]和MV-Robo Bench [6] 则要求对相机运动,假设运动和对象对应进行跨视角的推理.
SPAR-Bench [49]和VSI-Bench [42]进一步将这一评价扩展到室内场景和视频.
为了提高这些基准的绩效,大多数现有方法都培训了虚拟LM本身。
SpaceVLM [1] 接受合成空间问答对等培训,SpaceRGPT [3] 从3D场景图中学习区域表现,GASP [46] 从函文和深度一致性中获得监督,而不依赖于3D VQA数据.
另一行工作按照LLaVA-NEXT[21]中预训投影仪的精神,通过训练有素的接通器从额外的编码器中注入了特征.
Cambrian-1 [34] 从多个编码器中汇总出具有已学习过空间视野聚合器的特征,而Space-MLLM [39],VG-LLM [51]和VLM-3R [5]则通过已学习过的连接器或聚变模块来包含几何特征.
GeoReader [17] 列车 编码了预测深度和相机作为连续符号的阅读器,并随后将空间QA的VLM与阅读器被冻结进行微调.
由于每对编码器-甚高频必须重复进行这种培训,因此这些方法推广成本很高,不能适用于闭源甚高频。
相形之下,LatetParse既不需要学习到的连接器,也不需要任何VLM更新.

blocks.en: 2.2 Spatial Information in Vision Encoder Latents
blocks.zh: 2.2 愿景编码器中空间信息

blocks.en:
Probing studies investigate how much spatial information can be recovered from frozen vision features.
Probe3D [ 4 ] evaluates depth estimation, surface-normal prediction and cross-view correspondence, including on DINOv2 [ 27 ] features, and Lexicon3D [ 26 ] extends this analysis to 3D grounding, segmentation and registration.
Feat2GS [ 2 ] assesses the recovered geometry through novel-view synthesis, and DepthCLIP [ 50 ] shows that coarse depth can be read from CLIP [ 29 ] even without fitting a dedicated probe.
These findings establish that rich spatial information resides in encoder features, yet leave open whether a separate VLM can exploit it to answer spatial questions.
A related line of research performs reasoning directly in latent space.
Coconut [ 9 ] reasons in a continuous latent space, LatentMAS [ 53 ] exchanges hidden states among collaborating agents, and Latent Sketchpad [ 47 ] lets a model sketch within its own latent space.
These methods, however, operate on the model’s internal hidden states, which the model is trained to produce and interpret.
Our work instead draws on the patch features of external encoders, namely CLIP, DINOv3 [ 32 ] and VGGT [ 35 ] , whose channels bear no correspondence to the VLM’s visual tokens.
We therefore compare presenting these features directly as images with parsing the relations among their patches into textual evidence.
blocks.zh:
探险研究调查从被冻结的视觉特征中可以回收多少空间信息.
探测3D [4] 评估深度估计,地表常态预测和交叉视图对应,包括DINov2 [27] 特征,而Lexicon3D [26] 将这一分析扩展至3D地平面,分解和注册.
Feat2GS [2]通过小说-视觉合成来评估所恢复的几何学,而深度CLIP [50] 显示粗深可以从CLIP[29]读取,即使没有安装专用探测器.
这些研究结果确定,丰富的空间信息存在于编码器特征中,然而,对于单独的甚高频能否利用它来回答空间问题,则留有余地.
相关研究直接在潜在空间进行推理。
椰子 [9] 持续潜入空间的原因,LatentMAS [53] 合作者之间交换隐藏状态,Latent Sketchpad [47] 让模型在自己的潜入空间内作草图.
不过,这些方法在模型的内部隐藏状态上运作,模型经过了制作和解释的训练.
而我们的工作则借鉴了外部编码器的补丁特性,即CLIP,DINov3[32]和VGGT[35],其频道与VLM的视觉符号没有对应.
因此,我们将这些特征作为图像直接呈现出来,并将它们之间的关联分析成文字证据。

blocks.en: 2.3 Training-Free Visual Tool Use
blocks.zh: 2.3 免费培训视觉工具的使用

blocks.en:
Training-free methods equip a model with vision tools rather than modifying its weights.
VisProg [ 8 ] and ViperGPT [ 33 ] formulate visual reasoning as programs that invoke perception modules, and Visual Sketchpad [ 10 ] produces intermediate drawings for the VLM to inspect.
OpenVLHarness [ 52 ] retains tool outputs in a multimodal memory across steps, while MAIA [ 30 ] executes code to interpret model components rather than the scene itself.
Closer to our setting, SpatialPIN [ 24 ] supplies explicit 3D priors for spatial reasoning, and SandboxVLM [ 23 ] renders scene abstractions from 3D bounding boxes.
Perception Programs [ 11 ] condenses the outputs of depth, flow and correspondence tools into compact text, and Coarse Correspondences [ 20 ] overlays objects tracked across views directly on the images.
Such tool use is typically organized by an agent harness , which governs the tools available to a model, how each call is executed and what information persists between steps [ 38 , 44 ] .
Recent work adapts harnesses by refining prompts and workflows [ 12 , 16 , 19 , 28 , 37 , 41 , 48 ] , updating memory during deployment [ 14 , 40 ] , improving execution efficiency [ 22 ] , or training the model on harness edits and demonstrations [ 31 , 45 ] .
LatentParse adopts a fixed code-execution loop of this kind, in which a photo-blind analyst applies predefined tools to the patch features of off-the-shelf encoders and summarizes its findings in a report that the answering VLM reads alongside the photos.
Unlike prior methods that operate on images or on the decoded outputs of tools and task heads, our analyst measures relations within each encoder’s latent features, and rates each finding by cross-encoder consensus.
blocks.zh:
无培训方法为模型配备了视觉工具,而不是修改其重量。
VisProg [8]和ViperGPT [33] 制定可视推理作为引用感知模块的程序,而Visual Sketchpad [10] 制作中间图,供VLM检查.
OpenVLHarness [52] 在跨步骤的多模式内存中保留了工具输出,而MAIA [30] 执行代码来解释模型组件而不是场景本身.
靠近我们的设定, SpacePIN [24] 为空间推理提供清晰的 三维前缀, 和 SandboxVLM [23] 使场景抽象 从 三维边框。
概念程序[11]将深度、流量和通信工具的输出收缩成紧凑的文本,而粗糙的通信[20]将直接从图像上对视线进行跟踪的物体相重叠。
这种工具的使用通常由一种代理工具加以组织,这种工具管理着一个模型可用的工具、每个呼叫是如何执行的以及步骤[38、44]之间的信息持续存在。
近期的工作通过改进提示和工作流程[12、16、19、28、37、41、48],在部署期间更新记忆[14、40],提高执行效率[22],或对模型进行关于利用编辑和演示[31、45]的培训来调整利用。
LatentParse采用了这种固定的代码执行循环,其中相盲分析师对现成编码器的补丁特性应用了预先定义的工具,并在解答VLM与相片同时读取的报告中总结了它的调查结果.
与以往在图像或工具和任务头的解码输出上操作的方法不同,我们的分析师衡量每个编码器潜在特性内的关系,并以交叉编码器的共识对每个发现进行评分。

blocks.en: We draw latent features from three pretrained encoders whose training objectives capture different aspects of a scene. CLIP [ 29 ] is trained with image–text alignment and links object names to image regions. DINOv3 [ 32 ] is trained with self-supervision and produces features that match semantically similar regions within and across views. VGGT [ 35 ] is trained with multi-view 3D supervision and encodes how the views relate geometrically. From each encoder we take the patch tokens of the last layer and never use the depth, point or camera heads of VGGT. These latent features retain information that decoded outputs such as depth maps or 3D boxes [ 24 , 23 ] discard, and leave the choice of what to measure to the analyst. Table 9 compares other layers.

blocks.en: Localization proceeds in three stages. CLIP proposes a region for each object name, DINOv3 and VGGT verify it, and their consensus sets a confidence tier. CLIP’s proposal comes from text_map , which scores each patch against the prompt “a photo of ⟨ \langle object ⟩ \rangle ” and subtracts its mean score for five generic phrases. Because last-layer CLIP patch tokens are known to score a named object below its surroundings [ 18 ] , the map is smoothed and negated. locate then z-scores the map across all photos and selects the connected component of the top 8% of cells that contains the highest peak. support uses DINOv3 and VGGT to check which cells belong to the region, and cells supported by at least two encoders define its extent. Encoder consensus, region area, CLIP peak score and prominence set a confidence tier of high, medium, low or none, and locate_all applies this procedure to every named object. Figure 4 shows what text_map , DINOv3 similarity and VGGT matches find.

CLIP的建议来自text_map,它根据“X&langle object \\rangle相片”对每个补丁进行评分,并减去5个通用语的平均值。 由于上层CLIP补丁符号已知会在其周围下方得分出一个被命名的对象[18],因此地图被平滑并被否定. 然后查找 z- score 所有相片的映射, 并选择包含最高峰值的上8% 单元格的连接组件 。 支持使用 DINOv3 和 VGGT 来检查哪个单元格属于这个区域,由至少两个编码器支持的单元格定义它的范围。 编码器共识,区域,CLIP峰值得分和突出位置设置了高,中,低或无的置信级,并全部将这个程序应用于每个被命名的对象. 图4显示了文本_映射,DINOv3相似性和VGGT匹配的发现.

These quantities describe how the image changes rather than the camera pose. track instead follows a located object into the other photos using VGGT and DINOv3 patch matches, and CLIP checks the matched region wherever both encoders agree.

blocks.en: Several design choices in the tools are specified manually rather than learned, including the negated CLIP map, the top 8% of cells in locate and k = 5 k{=}5 in layout . The thresholds that define the confidence tiers and decide whether an encoder counts as reliable in motion are chosen once on 150 calibration questions (100 from 3DSRBench and 50 from MMSI-Bench) outside the development sample s 1 s_{1} ( Section 4 ) and reused in all experiments. They are set so that most high-tier boxes cover the named object, as judged by a VLM that sees the photo, and so that Gaussian noise almost never reaches the high tier or passes the reliability check. No answers are used in this process, and although the tools avoid learned decoding heads, they still involve task-specific design.

blocks.en: 3.3 Photo-Blind Analyst and Answering
blocks.zh: 3.3 相片闪烁分析员和回答

blocks.en: The analyst receives the question, the answer options, the number of views, the image dimensions and the latent features of CLIP, DINOv3 and VGGT, which we refer to as Multi-Latent features. It never sees the photos directly: it queries the features with tools, although its interpretation may also draw on the question and options. On benchmarks that mark targets with colored boxes or points, a rule-based color detector supplies the color and position of each marker ( Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 分析师接收了CLIP,DINOv3和VGGT的提问,答案选项,视图数量,图像维度和潜在特征,我们称之为多Latent特征. 它从不直接看到照片:它用工具询问特征,尽管它的解释也可能借鉴问题和选项。 在用有色框或点标出目标的基准上,基于规则的颜色探测器提供每个标记的颜色和位置(第4节.).

blocks.en: In the Agent-Directed mode , the analyst receives no predefined object list. It selects tools and their arguments from Table 1 and executes them in a sandbox over up to four steps, each of which can build on the printed outputs of earlier steps. A heuristic rule in the analyst’s prompt reads the image shifts from motion as camera motion, so that content moving left indicates that the camera turned or moved right. Image shifts alone do not determine the 3D motion uniquely. The analyst cannot call show and never views a rendering of the features. It completes a single pass without a critic, as illustrated in Figure 3 . This loop follows existing code-execution harnesses [ 16 , 31 , 37 ] , and differs in its tool library and restriction to latent features.
blocks.zh: 在 Agent-Directed 模式中,分析师没有收到预定义对象列表. 它从表1中选择工具及其参数,并在一个沙盒中执行,最多可达4个步骤,每个步骤可以借鉴更早步骤的印刷输出. 在分析师的提示中,一个弹性规则将图像从运动看成相机运动,这样内容向左移动就表明相机向右转或向右移动. 光是图像变换并不能确定独有的 三维运动 。 分析师不能调用显示,也永远不能查看特性的渲染. 如图3所示,它完成一个没有批评者的单个传球。 此回路遵循了现有的代码执行取用[16, 31, 37],并且其工具库和对潜在特性的限制不同.

blocks.en: After its final step, the analyst writes a report of up to six findings followed by a brief summary, where each finding is supported by numerical evidence and rated high, medium or low by cross-encoder consensus. The same VLM then answers the question in a fresh context from the photos, the question and this report, without access to the tools or the latent features. The answer therefore depends on the analysis only through the report.
blocks.zh: 在最后一步之后,分析员撰写了一份报告,报告内容多达6个调查结果,然后是一份简要摘要,其中每个调查结果都得到数字证据的支持,并被跨编码者的共识评为高、中或低等。 同一VLM随后从照片、问题和本报告中用新的语境回答了问题,没有工具或潜在特征。 因此,答案只取决于通过报告所作的分析。

blocks.en: To isolate the effect of the analyst’s tool choices, the Fixed-Sequence mode in Table 3 keeps the same tools and report format but removes the choice of tools from the analyst. A text-only call to the same VLM first extracts up to four object names from the question and options. Six code blocks then run in a predetermined order with the arguments listed in Table 1 , where motion uses up to seven photo pairs starting from the nearest and track runs at most eight times per question. The analyst then reads the outputs and writes the report.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离分析师工具选择的效果,表3中的固定序列模式保留了相同的工具和报告格式,但取消了分析师对工具的选择. 仅文本调用同一个VLM首先从问题和选项中取出最多四个对象名. 六个代码块随同表1所列参数按预定顺序运行,其中运动使用从最近处开始的最多7个相片对,每题最多运行8次. 分析员然后阅读产出并撰写报告。

blocks.en: MMSI-Bench [ 43 ] has 1,000 multi-view questions, from camera motion to multi-step reasoning. From MV-RoboBench [ 6 ] we take its 861 spatial questions, each with five options on synchronized views of one robot workspace in AgiBot World or BridgeV2. They ask which box marks the same object in another view, which boxed object is closest to grasp, where boxed objects sit in a 5 × 5 × 5 5{\times}5{\times}5 grid and which of five photos the wrist camera took with a given head view. SPAR-Bench-Tiny [ 49 ] has 550 multiple-choice questions in 11 tasks of 50 on ScanNet frames, 350 of them with two or three views. MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench mark targets with colored boxes or points drawn into the images. Since the analyst never sees the photos, a fixed color detector with no learned model gives it the color and position of each marker. Every VLM answers every question of the three sets.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that enables frozen VLMs to exploit the latent features of pretrained vision encoders for spatial reasoning. A photo-blind analyst parses the features of CLIP, DINOv3 and VGGT with basis-invariant tools and distills the evidence into a text report, which the VLM reads alongside the photos. While the tested grayscale feature images yield no consistent benefit, this report improves the mean accuracy of all five VLMs across three benchmarks, with the largest gains on MMSI-Bench camera-motion questions, suggesting that encoder latents become useful once the relations between their patches are made explicit. The Mismatched and Random Noise controls cover only Qwen3.8-27B on MMSI-Bench, multi-step reasoning declines without access to the photos, and letting the analyst choose its tools has not yet outperformed a predetermined sequence. Future work could combine photo and latent evidence adaptively per question.
blocks.zh: 我们提议LatentParse,这是一个无培训框架,使被冻结的VLM能够利用预先训练的视觉编码器的潜在特性进行空间推理。 一位相盲分析师用基不变量工具解析了CLIP,DINOv3和VGGT的特征,并将证据分解成文本报告,VLM与相片一起阅读. 虽然经过测试的灰度地物图像没有产生一致的好处,但本报告改进了所有五个VLM在三个基准上的平均准确性,在MMSI-Bench相机运动问题上取得了最大的收益,这表明,一旦其补丁之间的关系明确化,编码潜伏就变得有用了。 MMSI-Bench上的错配和随机噪声控制只覆盖了Qwen3.8-27B,多步推理在无法访问相片的情况下下降,让分析师选择其工具还没有超过预定序列. 今后的工作可以将照片和潜在证据适当结合到每个问题。

blocks.en: The thresholds of the tiers of locate , the bar of support and the two bars of motion in Table 6 come from one calibration run on 3DSRBench and MMSI-Bench questions, made before LatentParse ran on any full benchmark. The calibration reads no answer and no accuracy. For each question it names the objects as the analyst would, runs the tools on the Correct features and on Random Noise, and asks a VLM judge that sees the photo whether each box of locate lands on its object. The thresholds of locate admit the most objects whose high-tier boxes land on their object at least 65% of the time and whose medium-tier boxes do so at least 50% of the time, while at most 1% of Noise objects reach the high tier and at most 5% the high or medium tier. The inlier share of motion sits just above its 99th percentile of 0.18 under Noise, and the pt_agree bar of 0.1 lies well above its 99th percentile of 0.02 under Noise.

blocks.en: ⬇ You are the analyst . You do NOT see the photo ( s ). You get a spatial question and the raw latent features of the photo ( s ) from frozen vision models , loaded in a Python sandbox : - F [" clip "][ v ]: CLIP ViT - L /14 patch tokens , shape (16, 16, 1024): a 16 x16 grid over the whole photo ( squeezed to a square ). CLIP links image regions to words . - F [" vggt "][ v ]: VGGT aggregator tokens , shape ( h , 37, 2048). VGGT is a 3 D reconstruction model : its features encode surfaces , depth and viewpoint , computed jointly for all photos of a scene . - F [" dinov3 "][ v ]: DINOv3 ViT - L /16 patch tokens , shape ( h , 37, 1024), on exactly the VGGT grid ( same cells , same vggt_valid ). DINOv3 is a self - supervised image model : features of objects , parts and surfaces , computed for each photo on its own ( it never sees the other photos and has no notion of depth ). Nothing is decoded : there is no depth map , no 3 D points and no camera pose . CLIP ’ s grid is 16 x16 over the whole photo ; VGGT and DINOv3 share a grid of 14- pixel cells , 37 columns across the photo width ( a tall photo is centre - cropped ; vggt_valid [ v ] is False on padding rows ). Positions are photo fractions : x from the left , y from the top , both 0-1. Printouts number the photos 1, 2, ...; in code and in " regions ", view = photo number - 1. Your job is NOT to answer . Measure evidence in the latents that bears on the question , check it across latents , and say how reliable it is . There is no critic and no second round ; a separate model answers from the photo ( s ) and your findings . Tools that compare latents ( start with these ): - locate ( phrase , v = None ): CLIP ’ s text map ( already negated , so the named object scores highest ) finds the object in the photo where it peaks ( or in photo v ); VGGT and DINOv3 each check on their own which cells belong with CLIP ’ s blob . Prints photo , tier , box , area , centroid , peak , standout ( peak minus the best value elsewhere ), keep ( share of the core of CLIP ’ s blob each latent keeps ), iou_vggt_dinov3 and peaks per photo . tier is high , medium , low or none . locate_all ( phrases ) runs it for each phrase and marks two names that land on one region ( same_as ). - motion ( va , vb ): how the content moves from photo va to photo vb in each latent , from mutual patch matches : n , dx , dy ( median shift of the moving matches ; + = right / down ), static ( share not moving ), inl ( share that one shift + scale + rotation explains ; noise stays under 0.2), scale (> 1: content grows ), rot ( degrees ). reliable lists the latents with enough consistent matches ( an unreliable one shows only n and inl ); x , y and zoom give the direction of the reliable latents and how many agree (" left 3/3", " left 2/3 ( clip right )", " left ( only vggt )", " disagree ", " mixed ", " unreliable "); pt_agree is the share of cells VGGT and DINOv3 both match whose targets lie within one cell of each other ( chance is about 0.01). - track ( region , vb ): where a located region ( a locate result ) lands in photo vb in each geometry latent ( n , at , spread ); found yes / no / unclear ; only with yes : shift , beyond_camera ( shift minus the camera motion : the object ’ s own movement , or parallax ) and text_at vs text_peak ( CLIP ’ s map at the landing place vs its peak there ). - relate ( a , b ): region b relative to region a in one photo : dx , dy between centroids , size ( box area ratio ), iou , touch . - layout ( v ): k - means segments VGGT and DINOv3 share , and cka : how alike each pair of latents ’ maps are (0 unrelated , 1 the same structure ). - support ( model , seed , v ): the cells a latent itself groups with a seed region ( the seed is not forced in ). iou ( a , b , v ): overlap of two masks of photo v ( either grid ). Single - latent tools : text_map ( phrase , v , pooled = False ), top_region ( map , frac ), sim_to ( model , mask , v , mask_view ), grow ( model , seed , v ) ( its result always contains the seed , so it never confirms a region ), kmeans ( model , v , k , mask ), pca ( model , v , k , mask ), match ( va , vb , model , mask_a ), region_stats ( map , mask , v ), corr ( map_a , map_b , mask ), box ( x0 , y0 , x1 , y1 , model , v ), bbox ( mask , v ), to_vggt / to_clip ( map_or_mask , v ), describe ( map ), grid ( model , v ); photo_size , n_views and latents ( the latents in F ). numpy and scipy also work . Rules for reading the numbers : 1. Rely on a location , a motion or a relation only when the latents agree , and set each finding ’ s reliability from that agreement : - high : locate tier high ; a motion direction that every reliable latent gives , with at least two of them (" left 3/3", " left 2/2") and pt_agree >= 0.1 when VGGT and DINOv3 are both reliable ; track found yes . - medium : locate tier medium ; a direction with a dissenting latent (" left 2/3 (...)") or from one latent (" only ..."); track " yes ( only ...)". - low : anything else . " disagree ", " mixed ", " unreliable ", tier low or none , and track no or unclear are not evidence : say the latents are inconclusive on that point . Never settle a disagreement by picking the latent you prefer . 2. Agreement shows that a region is one coherent thing in several latents , not that it is the named object ; that rests on CLIP ’ s peak and standout . 3. Camera motion : content moving right from photo a to photo b means the camera turned or moved left ; content moving down means it tilted or moved up ; zoom " grows " means it moved toward the scene . A shift under one cell (0.027) is no movement . 4. State a relation between two objects only when both have tier high or medium ; left / right and above / below come from their centroids in one photo . 5. The latents carry no reliable signal for orientation : which way an object faces or points , or whether two objects are parallel or face the same way . Do not infer these ; say they are not measured . 6. PCA scores , similarities and cluster ids have arbitrary offset and scale : compare orderings and differences relative to the spread , never ratios , metres or angles . 7. If nothing reaches medium reliability , say the latents are inconclusive . Every finding must come from the latent numbers ( source " latent "); do not describe what the scene probably looks like . Write Python : exactly one ‘‘‘ python block per turn , at most 4 code steps ; variables persist between steps and each run gets an id ( E1 , E2 , ...). Print short summaries ( the tools above print compact lines ), never whole arrays . Then give your FINDINGS . In " regions ", give the box of each object the question names whose tier is high , or medium when track found it in another photo ( found yes ); view = photo number - 1. Leave out every other object . The boxes are drawn on the photo ( s ) for the model that answers , so a wrong box misleads it . When done , reply with a line starting with FINDINGS : followed by JSON ( at most 6 findings , most decisive first , each at most 60 words ): {" findings ": [{" text ": "< finding with its numbers , the tool and the latents >", " source ": " latent ", " evidence ": [" E2 "], " reliability ": " high | medium | low ", " why ": "< which latents agree or disagree >"}], " summary ": "< at most 80 words on what the latents show that bears on the question ; do not pick an option >", " regions ": [{" label ": "< object >", " view ": 0, " box ": [0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6]}]}

blocks.en: Table 11 isolates the source of the gain of LatentParse. The answering model and its input format stay fixed, and only what the analyst receives changes. With Question alone , the analyst writes its report from the question and the answer options, with no features and no tools. With Photos , it also sees the photos, still with no tools. With Pixels , the photo-blind analyst selects the same predefined tools, which run on the RGB patches of the photos on the grids of CLIP and VGGT in place of the features, without the tools that need CLIP’s text features. Photo only, LatentParse and the controls are rerun here on the same GPUs with the same batch size. Some questions have no answer in three of the runs, so accuracy is over the answered questions, each test uses the questions answered under both conditions, and the p p -values are not corrected for multiple comparisons. The gains of LatentParse on camera motion and on the four camera types remain significant after a Bonferroni correction over the 20 tests of Table 11 . All conclusions of this section hold when the questions without an answer are run again, so that every condition answers all 1,000 questions.
blocks.zh: 表11隔离了LatentParse收益的来源. 解答模式及其输入格式保持不变,只有分析师收到的变化。 分析师从问答选项中撰写报告, 照片显示, 有像素,相盲分析师选择了相同的被预先定义的工具,这些工具运行在CLIP和VGGT网格上的照片的RGB补丁上取而代之,而没有需要CLIP文本特性的工具. 只有相片,LatentParse和控件在这里重新运行 在同一批量大小的GPU上。 有的问题在三个跑道中都没有答案,因此准确度高于被回答的问题,每个测试都使用在两个条件下被回答的问题,而p-值没有被更正,用于多个比较. 在Bonferroni对表11的20个试验进行修正后,LatentParse在相机运动和4个相机类型上的收益仍然很大。 本节的所有结论都坚持当没有答案的问题再次运行时,这样每个条件都会回答所有1000个问题.

blocks.en: On the four camera question types, LatentParse raises accuracy from 32.7 % 32.7\% to 47.5 % 47.5\% , at 81 81 W/ 36 36 L and p < 10 − 4 p{<}10^{-4} , which reproduces the gain of the main text in an independent run. A report written from the question alone or from the photos does not differ significantly from photo only, on the four camera types together or over all questions ( p ≥ 0.14 p{\geq}0.14 ). The Multi-Latent features score higher than Pixels on each of the four camera types and reach 47.5 % 47.5\% against 41.9 % 41.9\% on the four together, where Pixels also beat photo only ( p = 0.003 p{=}0.003 ). The largest gain is on camera motion, from 36.5 % 36.5\% to 68.1 % 68.1\% at 23 23 W/ 1 1 L.
blocks.zh: 关于四个相机问题类型,LatentParse将精度从32.7% 32.7%提高到47.5% 47.5%,在81 81 W/36 36 L和p < 10 - 4 p-QQ-10-4}中,该精度在独立运行中复制了正文的增益. 仅从问题或照片上写出的报告与照片没有显著区别,只涉及四个相机类型,或涉及所有问题(第0.14页,p{\geq}0.14)。 多光度特性在四种相机类型中各得分都高于像素,并达到47.5% 47.5分,而四相机组合的比分为41.9% 41.9分,比分也仅比相机(p = 0.003 p = 0.003). 最大的收益来自相机运动,从36.5% 36.5分到68.1% 68.1分,在23 W/ 1 L.

blocks.en: In 68 questions, one option is “Cannot be determined” or “None of the above”, and it is the correct answer in 49 of them. A report that calls the evidence inconclusive moves the answer toward this option, so every analyst input gains on these questions, from 33.8 % 33.8\% for photo only to between 57.4 % 57.4\% and 77.9 % 77.9\% . The gain of the Multi-Latent features is thus concentrated on camera questions, as in the main text.

blocks.zh: SPAR-Bench-Tiny 第673个问题在第一张照片中标出有红色盒子的纸并询问在第二张照片中四个盒子中哪一个拿着. 分析师没有看到任何一张照片,就用CLIP和DINOv3在第二张照片中找到纸张,它报告的盒子覆盖了备选案文B. LatetParse answers B,这是正确的。
